note: HR prints the customer's business facts directly in the Instructions (DECISIONS 88, option B). These are the only variables an HR Instructions set may use. Any other {{var.*}} is an error; so is an unresolved slot such as <business name>. This list replaces docs/shared/variables.json for HR. hr_lookup_tool, leave_balance_tool, leave_request_tool, interview_schedule_tool and calls_recorded are intake flags, not variables: the skill writes the Instructions for the chosen state and names a tool only when it is on. 'status: unconfirmed' means the platform has not confirmed the variable exists.

variables.name: now_local
variables.description: Today's date and time for the call, with the dates of the coming days. Every date the agent says is read off this list.

variables.name: contact_name
variables.description: Outbound calls: the name of the person being called (a candidate or a new joiner). Used only to ask whether the person on the line is that person; never said to anyone who is not confirmed, never left on a voicemail. Whether the platform passes this is an open question; when empty the agent asks whether it is speaking with the person who has been in touch with the business.

variables.name: call_details
variables.description: Outbound calls: the facts for this call in the business's own words (the interview time and place, the documents needed, or the joining details). The only source for what the agent says about the matter. Never extended, guessed or worked out; a full address or phone number in it is never read out. When empty the agent gives no details and offers a callback. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.
